title: Farm archive and schematic viewer refresh
summary: Improved farm metadata, upload ordering, YouTube descriptions, and the interactive schematic preview.
description: The November 14 release connects farm records to current YouTube upload metadata across the TheySix channels, improves the farm detail pages, and refreshes the browser schematic experience.

items: Farm cards now show YouTube view totals when available.
Farm titles, descriptions, and dates can use the linked video metadata, with dates normalized to YYYY-MM-DD in the interface.
Newest and oldest sorting follows upload timestamps indexed from TheySix, TheySixMC, TheySixCreations, TheySixMinecraftJava, and TheySixBedrock.
The metadata importer now extracts fuller descriptions, publish dates, and view counts while saving progress safely.
Farm detail pages now present cleaner tutorial descriptions and helpful viewer notes without the old staff-approval wording.
The schematic viewer now opens with a focused 3D build view, fullscreen controls, screenshots, reset camera, and material extraction.
Added browser-side farm activation for supported redstone simulations, with a clear fallback when a schematic cannot be simulated.
Added searchable material lists, copyable material totals, and per-block visibility controls.
Improved renderer lifecycle handling to prevent disposed-camera resize errors and added a responsive farm detail loading skeleton.
